verdict.rationale: Disclosing the basis for approval or success rates is a fair question for an immigration-services provider, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no advertised approval or success rate on LegalOS pages. It also shows no case counts, time windows, or methodology statements attached to any outcome claims. The only performance-style claims are speed claims, such as "as little as 48 hours" and "48–72 hours", and these come with no stated basis either.
